statement: Open Question 1. Prove the sequential function composition task is hard for log-depth Transformer. In particular, for any L ≤ log(n), prove L-layer Transformer could not solve L-sequential function composition when Hdp ≤ n−O(L) . Our current construction inherently cannot surpass logarithmic depth, as the function size necessarily grows exponentially. A natural and intriguing question thus arises: Can we establish a polynomial-depth lower bound for Transformers? We propose a potential approach informed by two core observations underlying our current proof: (1) the information bottleneck induced by attention mechanisms, and (2) the autoregressive property inherent to decoders. We believe these insights can extend significantly further.
